title: MCPL action entry
description: One thing an application accepts or does. `tool` is the upstream MCP tool definition, unchanged, so the same entry can be served over MCP as-is. `mcpl` is what MCPL adds. Draft 0.1, not accepted.

mcpTool.description: UPSTREAM. MCP 2026-07-28 Tool data type, read from the specification page on 2026-11-13. Field list: name, title, description, icons, inputSchema, outputSchema, annotations.

name.description: UPSTREAM: 1 to 128 characters; letters, digits, underscore, hyphen, dot.

inputSchema.description: UPSTREAM: a valid JSON Schema object, 2020-12 unless `$schema` says otherwise. MCPL tightening: must be type object with additionalProperties false, so a proposal cannot carry a field the application did not declare.

annotations.description: UPSTREAM: optional hints, untrusted unless from a trusted server. `readOnlyHint` is confirmed in host documentation; the full member list for 2026-07-28 is UNVERIFIED.

mcplAction.description: MCPL. Everything here is ours, not a standard.

consequence.description: How much damage a wrong call can do. Drives the approval route.

approval.description: none: no approval. host: the host's own prompt, recorded as host-attested. served-page: a page the application serves, where the application itself observes the request. This is stronger than a host report but is not yet proof of a human act; the assurance model is unwritten (INCRAM ledger, R2 cross-check).

undo.description: The action that reverses this one, by tool name, or null with a stated reason.

preview.description: Plain-language template shown before approval. Placeholders in braces name inputSchema properties.

screen.description: Declared route in the application where the result appears, so MCPL can hand back a link.

posture.description: Postures in which the action is offered. Foundational is the default when nothing is stated.

guards.description: Named checks run on a proposal after schema validation and before preview. Defined in core part 2 (rules).

outside_boundary.description: What MCPL says when a request touches this action's area but is not something the application declares.
